title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Courtesy Reissue of the Most Recently Lapsed Finch Note
content:
## When this applies

A member of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program asks in person for the courtesy reissue of a Finch Note. For a courtesy reissue this policy handles, and only for such a reissue, the note that may be reissued once as a courtesy at the member's request is the member's most recently lapsed note, and only when it lapsed with its validity ended; the request is recorded as an expired note reissue request, and a birthday note, a note that lapsed because the membership closed and a note already reissued are still never reissued. For such a reissue the reissued note keeps the original note's value and names the original note, and its expiry date is the reissue date plus the courtesy validity days less one day; every other note keeps its standing expiry rule.

## When the reissue is granted and its validity fixed

A courtesy reissue is not granted until every refunded return of merchandise paid in part with a Finch Note shows its reinstatement note on the membership.

The courtesy note's validity is fixed only after every refunded return of a purchase that earned points shows its return deduction entry on the membership's points history.

Read the other way: while any refunded return of merchandise paid in part with a Finch Note has no reinstatement note showing on the membership, the courtesy reissue is not granted; and while any refunded return of a purchase that earned points has no return deduction entry showing on the points history, the courtesy note's validity is not yet fixed.

## Submitting the request: `request_courtesy_note_reissue_8b12a7a8`

**Capability.** The member submits, in person, a courtesy reissue request for a Finch Note of theirs that lapsed unused, and the courtesy note is issued at once. The request is recorded as a completed expired note reissue request naming the lapsed note; one new note with its own code, marked as a courtesy reissue and naming the lapsed note, is issued today with the given value and stays valid for the given number of days counting today as day 1; and the membership's Finch Notes balance rises by that value. The member sees the new note in the app at once.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own tool. Customer care unlocks `request_courtesy_note_reissue_8b12a7a8` and hands it over, and the customer themselves submits it with the values below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the member's Finch Circle membership, as returned by the membership lookup | identifier |
| `original_note_code` | the code of the lapsed Finch Note being reissued, exactly as it appears in the member's note history | copied character for character, verbatim |
| `return_id` | the reference number of a return record the note is tied to, as returned by the return lookup; a courtesy reissue is tied to no return, so the empty value is passed | identifier, empty here |
| `note_amount` | the value of the reissued note | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent |
| `validity_days` | how many calendar days the reissued note stays valid, counting the reissue date as day 1 | a whole number of days |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("reissued" when the request was recorded and the note created); `request_id` (reference number of the completed reissue request); `note_code` (code of the new note, FN- followed by 8 characters); `note_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `issue_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); `expiry_date` (last valid day, YYYY-MM-DD); `notes_balance` (the new Finch Notes balance, USD, 2 decimal places).
